evidence: Arithmetic (frozen task bytes): task.toml [agent].timeout_sec=7200, [environment].build_timeout_sec=600, [verifier].timeout_sec=13200; judge timeouts gates/render 600, gates/constraints 600, scored/functional 9000, scored/polish 900, scored/visual 900; test.sh run_suite budgets gates 1500, scored 11100, with rewardkit --max-concurrent-agent 1 (sequential). Each gate judge 600 < 1500 and gate sum 1200 < 1500; each scored judge (9000/900/900) < 11100 and scored sum 10800 < 11100; gates+scored 1500+11100=12600 < 13200 leaving 600 s for the 30 s liveness probe (120x0.25 s), copy and two score.py runs; sum of all judges 12000 < 13200 (internal annotation). Liveness: readiness 30 s, restart_mcp HELPER_TIMEOUT_SEC=55 > restart helper's 5 s kill wait + 30 s probe. All max values < 5 h (18000 s). Template preservation: test.sh byte-identical to template, restart_mcp.py identical, judge timeouts and task.toml timeout lines identical to template and staged-task-contract.md:111 (1500/11100/13200); no unauthorized timeout change. Measured adequacy (v15 hosted, same golden, same judge timeouts 600/600/9000/900/900 recorded in reward-details, same criterion counts 1/2/43/6/3): oracle verifier 19:35:13->20:08:44 (~2011 s, reward 1.0), gpt-5.6-luna verifier 19:44:39->20:36:59 (~3140 s, reward 0.5746, exception_info null), nop 70 s; whole verifier including all five judges < 9000 s functional budget alone, i.e. >=4x headroom against 13200; no timeout exceptions. GPT agent execution 9m10s vs 7200 s agent budget. Counterexample attempts: a hung/broken app that stalls the browser is bounded by judge 9000 then suite timeout 11100 -> run_suite non-zero -> exit 0 with zero reward pre-written (no verifier overrun, no false credit); a slow-but-conforming app gets ~3x measured functional headroom, so a timeout-induced false fail is unlikely. Residual risk (why risk=true): no configured-judge run exists on these exact v16 bytes (raw-evidence-index scope says so; functional criteria text and app_context changed from v15), and no cold build timing for build_timeout_sec=600 was measured (hosted env setup 3 s indicates a cached image). The scripted golden duration is not judge duration and was not used as timing evidence.
suggested_fix: No config change. Record a full configured-judge timing (gates + scored wall time) on the v16 bytes, and a cold docker build time for both Dockerfiles, before clearance.
